title: Durable portfolio product context
intent: Keep future design, application, and release work grounded in a current product record rather than legacy design-register assumptions or conversational memory.

criteria.criterion: PRODUCT.md uses Impeccable product schema 1, declares the web platform, and contains no deprecated Register section.
The record includes users, purpose, positioning, operating context, capabilities and constraints, brand commitments, evidence, product principles, and accessibility and inclusion.
The primary user and success condition remain a time-pressed hiring reader making an evidence-backed decision about Jamie's role fit and next action.
The product record identifies the governed Knowledge Wiki Graph as the mechanism that turns project sources and evidence into selective public portfolio and application materials.
The record separates access, evidence, consent, publication, deployment, and indexing authority; preserves collective credit; and keeps production publication under Jamie's human approval.
Evidence on hand points to public-safe repository surfaces without exposing protected filesystem paths, archive identifiers, credentials, or private-source locators.
